_comment: Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Replace <PLACEHOLDERS>. Remove servers you do not need.

filesystem._comment: Read-only access to a project directory. Restrict allowed paths tightly — anything listed here is fully readable by the model.

github._comment: Reads issues, PRs, code search across repos. Token must be a fine-grained PAT scoped to the repos you want the model to see.

sequential-thinking._comment: Gives the model a structured scratchpad for multi-step reasoning. No external network, safe to leave on.

memory._comment: Optional. Persists facts across conversations into a local SQLite store. Disable if you prefer ephemeral sessions.
